'''Geo Cthon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was married to [[Jeela Cthon]] and together, they owned and operated ''[[Lucky You]]'', a service that used amateur actors to allow people to pretend that they had a better life.
